name: datarefine.duplicate-fuzzy-matcher
description: Find possible duplicate values in a text column, review similarity groups, and merge variants into a chosen canonical value.

views.title: Duplicate Matcher
views.body: Select a text column, preview possible match groups, then apply one undoable canonical-value merge. Original rows are not deleted. Ignore groups by entering their numbers from the preview.

fields.label: Text column
fields.hint: Names, addresses, email-like values, and other text columns work best.

fields.label: Matching method
fields.hint: Hybrid combines edit, Jaro-Winkler, n-gram, and phonetic signals.

fields.label: Similarity threshold (%)
fields.hint: Higher is stricter. Try 85–92 for names; normalized matches are always grouped.

fields.label: Minimum group size
fields.hint: Counts variants or repeated rows, whichever is larger.

fields.label: Max unique values to compare
fields.hint: A safety limit to prevent an accidental expensive all-pairs comparison.

fields.label: Ignore group numbers
fields.hint: Optional. Enter numbers shown by Preview; ignored groups are not changed.

options.label: Preview possible match groups
options.hint: Read-only analysis; no cells are changed.

options.label: Merge into canonical values
options.hint: Applies the reviewed groups as one undoable operation. Rows are preserved.
